Alternatively, we can just call set_navigation with a dummy destination like "Home". But unclear.

Alternatively, we can just call set_navigation with "Your destination" as a string. But the function expects a string. It's okay.

But the user didn't specify a destination. So maybe we just call set_navigation with "Your destination" as placeholder.

Thus plan: call check_tire_pressure. If any <30, call find_nearest_tire_shop. Then call set_navigation to navigate to shop. If no shop found, do nothing. If all >=30, call set_navigation with "Your destination".

Let's implement.
